body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Do not accept Strain on this card. Remove 1 Strain; suppress one ordinary pain or Poison penalty until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: Extend suppression through the end of your next turn.
Suppress one Light physical Wound Condition's numerical penalties until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Strain - Trance
rider.html: Enter Somatic Trance until the end of your next turn: ignore 1 point of the Composure penalty caused by your current Strain. The Strain remains and other penalties still apply.
